releases.notes:
**Governing Changes in Self-Evolving Agents**

Majid Babaei. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Software Engineering; not accepted or published. Introduces SSEVOH-DSL and Foundational Contracts for version-bound approval, dependency quarantine, withdrawal through recorded origins, and eligible recovery. Evaluated in one self-evolving host; broader portability remains untested. Submission confirmed by the author on November 13, 2026. Research artifact: https://github.com/ai4se4ai-lab/SSEVOH-DSL.
